name: vscode
description: Run NanoClaw agents on this machine and work with them from the editor.

enumDescriptions: Sign in with Microsoft (Entra). For installs behind App Service authentication.
No sign-in: central knows you by your network identity (Tailscale, or an identity-aware proxy).
nanoclaw.signIn.description: How this machine proves who you are to central. Central supplies it; set here to override.

nanoclaw.appIdUri.description: Application ID URI of the App Service's Entra registration, e.g. api://<client-id>. The token's audience. Central supplies it; set here to override.

nanoclaw.tenantId.description: Entra tenant ID (workforce tenant). Central supplies it; set here to override.

nanoclaw.clientId.description: Optional: your own native app registration to sign in with (VSCODE_CLIENT_ID). Leave empty to use VS Code's Microsoft app. Central supplies it; set here to override.

nanoclaw.autoConnect.description: Connect on startup when signed in.

nanoclaw.slots.markdownDescription: Project slots: maps a container path central declares (e.g. `/workspace/project`) to a local directory. A slot that is not bound here is refused.

nanoclaw.mountAllowlist.markdownDescription: Directories a slot may resolve into (symlinks followed). Empty = the folders open in this window.

nanoclaw.containerRuntime.markdownDescription: Container runtime for sessions placed on this machine. `auto` tries `docker` then `podman`. Docker Desktop or a Podman machine both work; the relay runs inside the container, so no host listener or WSL remote is needed.

nanoclaw.runtimePath.description: Optional: full path of the docker/podman CLI when it is not on PATH.

enumDescriptions: Build the agent image on this machine from the context central sends. No registry needed; the first build takes several minutes and fetches from Docker Hub, apt, npm and GitHub.
Pull a prebuilt agent image and retag it to the name central expects. Uses the reference below, or central's pin when that is empty. Nothing is built here.
nanoclaw.agentImage.markdownDescription: How this machine obtains the agent image for sessions placed on it. `pull` requires the runtime to be logged in to the registry already (`docker login` / `podman login`); a pulled image is rejected if it bakes a different agent-runner than central expects. Applies only when central's image source is "Machine decides"; by default central has every runner build the image.

nanoclaw.agentImageRef.markdownDescription: Image reference to pull when `#nanoclaw.agentImage#` is `pull` — a corporate mirror or any registry this machine can reach, e.g. `myregistry.azurecr.io/nanoclaw/agent@sha256:…`. Pin by digest. Empty means: use the reference central is pinned to. Applies only when central's image source is "Machine decides"; by default central has every runner build the image.

nanoclaw.allowUnlabeledAgentImage.markdownDescription: Accept a pulled image that carries no agent-runner lock label (a `save`/`load` or third-party image). Off by default: without the label the image's runtime cannot be checked against what central expects.

enumDescriptions: Bind the first open workspace folder to /workspace/project when central declares that slot (read/write).
Never bind the workspace automatically; a declared /workspace/project slot must be set in nanoclaw.slots or the session is refused.
nanoclaw.workspaceMount.markdownDescription: How the developer's project reaches an agent placed on this machine. Central declares the slot `/workspace/project`; this machine decides which folder fills it. An explicit `nanoclaw.slots` entry for that path always wins.

nanoclaw.workspaceExcludes.markdownDescription: Secret-like paths hidden from the agent inside a bound slot (an empty read-only mount covers each match). Patterns are relative to the slot root; a pattern without `/` matches a file or folder name anywhere; `*`, `?` and `**` are supported. Central may add patterns per placement; the union applies. Only paths that exist when the container is created are covered.

enumDescriptions: Ask before installing a newer runner build that central serves.
Install a newer build as soon as central announces it, then offer a reload.
nanoclaw.autoUpdate.markdownDescription: How to handle a newer runner build that NanoClaw central serves. The package is downloaded over the same signed-in connection, its hash checked against what central announced, and installed through VS Code.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out nanoclaw-$npm_package_version.vsix
scripts.harness:editor: npm run build && npm run build:core && harness/editor-docker.sh
